sarah: Quick follow-up on an ingress pressure hint + resumable-trailer idea. High-level: cheap numeric header for realtime hints, aggregated metrics for trends, and an opt-in `Edge-Resume` trailer for checkpointing streams.

alex: Two quick things: perf impact of adding a header at dispatch; privacy for multi-tenant clusters.

sarah: Perf: header built from an atomic queue-depth read at dispatch time; gated by `edge.backpressure_headers.enabled` and per-route `route.backpressure.visibility`. Privacy: header only contains numeric fields, e.g. `X-Edge-Pressure: lvl=2;q=48;win=7`. No tenant ids.

jamie: Semantic mapping for lvl? Is lvl advisory or will we enforce rejects?

sarah: Proposal: lvl=0 healthy; 1 advisory (suggest batching); 2 constrained (prefer client retry+backoff); 3 shed (gateway may reject low-priority). SDKs should treat lvl=1 as a hint.

mike: Streaming: if we preempt mid-stream, trailers are messy. How do tokens/billing work?

sarah: Trailers gated per-route. Example trailer: `Edge-Resume: token=base64url...;offset=1536;lvl=3;exp=170`. Contract: resumed calls billed only for new tokens generated after resume. Keep checkpoint metadata for short TTL (default 5m). Model-rollover invalidates tokens.

alex: Include token format: model-version prefix + window id + HMAC, expiry 5m, size cap ~64 bytes. Single-use optional per-route.

jamie: Observability: aggregate histograms (q depth, admit latency) scraped every 10s; sample traces at admit when lvl>=2 or trailer emitted. Dashboards: "Ingress pressure heatmap"; alert on sustained lvl>=2 >60s.

mike: Retry storms: header is advisory; if we must force, return 429 + `Retry-After` and include `Edge-Backoff: base=250;jitter=0.25;mode=exp` as a hint.

sarah: Bench plan: microbench hotpath with header on/off (p50/p99, CPU). Feature flags: global and per-route. Dedicated/private clusters can opt-out.

ops-bot: RFC-1367 staged to edge-canary-2; canary window 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic.

sarah: I'll push a short spec with header schema, trailer schema, sampling rules, feature flags, and recommended SDK defaults. Thanks. :thumbsup:
